name: Addon review tool
description:
## Why?

The addon review tool ([`shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config`](https://github.com/shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config) → `review_tool/review.js`) surfaces ESLint findings as GitHub Actions **check annotations**. On every PR push the annotations are re-emitted and old ones are never cleared, so identical findings pile up — the same `no-console` (R3) and `no-unused-vars` (R6) appear multiple times on one line (see screenshot). For partner addon repos that call this reusable workflow multiple times, the review is noisy.

## What?

Deliver findings as **inline PR review comments** instead of accumulating check annotations, and reconcile them across pushes so nothing duplicates:

- Findings post as inline review comments via the workflow's `GITHUB_TOKEN` (`github-actions[bot]`).
- On PR update, reconcile: skip findings already commented, remove comments for findings that no longer exist.
- Keep **one overall status check** (Checks API) — blockers fail it and gate merge; per-line detail lives in the comments.
- Runs automatically on pull request `opened`, `reopened`, and `synchronize`.
- Review the current rule set (stock ESLint + `shoptet/*`) and confirm each rule's relevance and severity (blocker vs recommend).

## Acceptance Criteria

- ☐ ESLint findings are posted as inline PR review comments on the changed lines via `GITHUB_TOKEN`; individual-finding check annotations are removed.
- ☐ On PR `synchronize`, the tool reconciles comments — no finding is duplicated across pushes, and comments for resolved findings are removed.
- ☐ A single check run reports overall pass/fail: blockers fail the check (gate merge), recommendations do not.
- ☐ The review runs automatically on pull request `opened`, `reopened`, and `synchronize`.
- ☐ The current rule set is audited; each rule's relevance and severity (blocker/recommend) is confirmed or adjusted.
- ☐ Verified on a test PR: pushing new commits creates no duplicate comments, and fixing a finding removes its comment.
